protocol.reader_target: Actual future correctness of this exact new joint content checkpoint, not old frozen-head correctness
protocol.future_target_builder: TRAIN-only complete legal accepted-prefix tree beginning with mandatory A1. Compute each actual model step/classification once per unique tree node. Exact one/two-READ descendants are explicit target references, not independent forward calls or new objects.
protocol.value_features: Full six-slot accepted normalized row55 history and mask; current joint-head probabilities padded to six classes; exact next two READ identities in their actual order. No IDs, labels, unrequested observations, teacher posteriors or future states.
protocol.read_order: Two ordered six-way one-hots: modality x source endpoint. Order-sensitive recurrence forbids collapsing to endpoint level pair.
protocol.wait_semantics: Logical wall-clock wait never changes accepted content or source-clock state. A shared pure public release/latency simulation first truncates the plan to actually accepted READs before deadline. Late issued READs are charged but omitted from content targets; READs after WAIT reaches deadline are not issued. If no READ is accepted, future correctness equals STOP. Only the accepted ordered READ subpath enters value features.
protocol.reader_architecture: Common 354->32->1 tanh MLP, BCE-with-logits; fixed FP64 parameters and optimizer shape for every content family
protocol.common_reader_randomness: Every family of a task/seed receives identical reader initialization from seed+500000 and identical minibatch index stream from seed+600000; both SHA256 identities are retained and checked before candidate freeze.
protocol.calibration: Historical VAL only. Five fixed bins floor(5*p), cap4, Laplace(1,1), empty bins use global smoothed rate. STOP bins use max raw class probability with actual correctness; future bins use raw value sigmoid with actual descendant correctness.
protocol.initial_failure: No accepted prefix returns smoothed TRAIN class prior; its STOP correctness is calibrated with VAL empty-history prior predictions. No random model fallback or hidden future lookup.
protocol.primary_2x2: Ordinary family versus hx_full, each under common fixed schedule and common value controller; report B-A,D-C,C-A,D-B and interaction for each predeclared ordinary family. Light is an additional descriptive baseline.
protocol.light: Fixed threshold0.8 on calibrated current correctness, else one earliest next source prefix, modality value lexical tie; no future forecasts
protocol.service: Frozen V8 PreparedPrefixService, real array selection/copy; LogicalClock deterministic source release plus0.001second/read. Primary service has no injected failure; separate contract controls cover charged errors/timeouts. No live media latency claim.
protocol.evaluation: Historical TEST development replay only after exact new content candidates, value weights/calibration and source publication. Previously exposed cohort is not independent confirmation.
protocol.pre_VAL_gate: Verify original content PLAN source/input hashes, all36 untouched-TEST checkpoints/norms, current control source, and their membership in the root-verified published equivalent local Git tree. All tasks' TRAIN warehouse hashes must match original content-training identities before any VAL loader runs.
limits: Fixed update count is not CPU matching
Correlated prefix/descendant rows are not independent calibration samples
No validation-selected hyperparameters or post-test threshold adjustment
Native-family readers do not qualify new execution-channel interventions
This does not close qualified strong-frontend, full financial-parameter learning, continuous-reset or net-adoption gates

calibration_role: historical VAL; correlated prefixes, no independent qualification
